name: Alloy
typeSystem: A minimal, statically checked relational logic: every expression denotes a relation, with a scalar represented as a singleton unary relation; signatures declare typed sets, and fields declare typed relations between them.
runtime: There is no execution in the traditional sense: the Alloy Analyzer translates a model and an assertion or predicate into a Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problem and hands it to a SAT solver to find an instance or establish that none exists within the selected finite scope.

runtimes.name: Alloy Analyzer (JVM, SAT-based)
runtimes.role: Java tool that translates Alloy models to SAT instances and calls an underlying SAT solver such as MiniSat or Glucose to search for satisfying instances within a bounded scope.

compilers.name: Alloy Analyzer
compilers.role: Compiles Alloy specifications to CNF for SAT solving and renders any found instance as a visual object graph.

concurrencyModel: N/A (declarative modelling and bounded model-checking language, not an execution language)

codeExample.caption: A signature and a fact constraining a simple ancestor relation
